continuous_interval: 10000 bootstrap resamples of trial means; seed 6216
paired_difference_interval: Conservative Bonferroni-adjusted marginal exact binomial bounds; paired exact McNemar with Holm correction within method/disturbance families
failure_selection: At most six: first failed seed, none before disturbance; first two reference-method task failures, then first four comparator task/method failures in config order. Preserve matched iterative trial regardless of outcome. Hero: lowest successful complete/iterative/none seed, if any.
interpretation: New frozen three-mode feedback evaluation, independent of historical 240/40 trials. Development uses seed 0; 300-309 reserved. No guaranteed improvement. Open-loop retains common initial acquisition and visual feed prediction but disables post-grasp and post-release relocalization. Staged and iterative share estimator, depth correction and controller parameters; iterative additionally performs bounded repeated observations/corrections before contact. Dynamics advance by fixed simulated latency at feedback observations; wall inference/planning pauses remain explicit, so this is not a realtime hardware claim. All modes retain joint servo, force and collision guards.
